verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to supply dialogue audio, generate speech, or drive a character's lip movement from an audio track. Modify Video can preserve the lip sync already present in source footage, and Ray can transfer facial expressions from a source performance. Both are adjacent video-to-video features, and using them this way would be a user workaround of filming the dialogue yourself, not audio-matched lipsync.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
